description: This file contains functions related to platform-specific upgrade procedures for openwrt on the rockchip armv8 target. It includes operations such as checking the image, copying configuration, and performing the upgrade process by manipulating disk partitions and images.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks whether the provided image matches the current partition layout, ensuring compatibility before upgrade.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to the target partition during upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process by writing new images and partition tables to disk, handling partition updates and UUID writes.
